notes.title: 2027 英语一小作文模板
notes.html:
2027 英语一小作文模板（应用文 10 分）

以下是按公开考试要求整理的原创框架，不是官方答案。考场要先读题、圈出全部要点，再选框架，不要整段照搬。

一、阅卷先看什么

  1. 内容要点：题目要求写几点，就覆盖几点；漏一点通常直接掉档。
  2. 格式与语域：称呼、落款、正式/非正式语气是否匹配。
  3. 语言准确：时态、主谓一致、单复数、拼写。
  4. 连贯：句间有连接，段落清楚，不堆砌套话。

二、通用三段结构

段落作用篇幅
第一段称呼 + 说明写信目的1–2 句
第二段主体：2–3 个要点，逐条展开4–6 句
第三段礼貌收尾 + 期待回复 + 署名1–2 句

开头目的句（任选，不要每篇都用同一句）：

  • I am writing to suggest that …
  • I am writing to recommend … to you.
  • I am writing to invite you to …
  • I am writing to apologize for …
  • I am writing to apply for …

结尾句：

  • I would appreciate it if you could take my suggestion into consideration.
  • I hope you will find this recommendation helpful.
  • I look forward to your reply at your earliest convenience.
  • Please accept my sincere apology again.

三、按题型准备

1. 建议信

开头：I am writing to share some suggestions regarding …

主体句块：

  • First and foremost, it would be advisable to …
  • In addition, consideration should be given to …
  • It would also be helpful if …

收尾：I hope these suggestions will be of some help.

易错点：只写建议、不写理由；语气过硬（应使用 would / could / it might be better to）。

2. 推荐信

开头：I am writing to recommend … to you.

主体句块：

  • The main reason for my recommendation is that …
  • What makes it stand out is …
  • It is particularly suitable for you because …

收尾：I am convinced that you will benefit a lot from it.

易错点：推荐对象和自己经历脱节；只夸不举具体例子。

3. 邀请信

开头：I am writing to invite you to …

主体句块：

  • The event is scheduled to take place in … on …
  • It would be a great pleasure if you could join us.
  • Please let me know whether you are available.

收尾：I am looking forward to your presence.

易错点：时间、地点、活动内容三要素缺一；忘记询问对方是否方便。

4. 道歉信

开头：I am writing to express my sincere apology for …

主体句块：

  • The reason why I failed to … is that …
  • To make up for it, I would like to …
  • I fully understand the inconvenience I have caused.

收尾：Please accept my apology once again.

易错点：只道歉不补救；把责任推给对方。

5. 通知 / 告示

格式：标题（Notice）+ 正文 + 落款（组织 + 日期）。

主体句块：

  • A … will be held in … on …
  • Those who are interested are welcome to sign up before …
  • For further information, please contact …

易错点：写成私人信件；缺报名方式或截止时间。

6. 申请信

开头：I am writing to apply for …

主体句块：

  • I believe I am qualified for this position because …
  • My experience in … has equipped me with …
  • I would be grateful if you could offer me an opportunity.

收尾：Thank you for your consideration.

易错点：只写愿望、不写能力证据；语气过于随意。

四、可替换的连接与语气

  • 递进：first of all / in addition / moreover / what is more
  • 转折：however / nevertheless / on second thought
  • 因果：therefore / as a result / consequently
  • 礼貌：I would appreciate it if … / It would be kind of you to …

五、常见扣分点

  1. 称呼写错：给朋友用 Dear Sir or Madam，或给机构用 Dear Tom。
  2. 署名写成中文或真实姓名；题目没要求时用 Li Ming。
  3. 要点漏写；尤其“说明原因”“提出建议”“表达感谢”这类动词。
  4. 全篇简单句堆叠，没有连接。
  5. 字数明显不足（小作文通常 100 词左右）。

六、考前检查清单

  • [ ] 题目要求的要点是否逐条覆盖？
  • [ ] 称呼、落款、语气是否匹配对象？
  • [ ] 每段是否有明确中心句？
  • [ ] 时态是否统一（尤其邀请、道歉、通知）？
  • [ ] 是否出现拼写、主谓一致、单复数错误？
  • [ ] 是否留出 2 分钟通读并改错？

notes.title: 石雷鹏小作文背诵10篇（英一）
notes.html:
第一章 小作文话题预测

小作文01 通知/告示：介绍＋邀请

题目要求

Directions:

Suppose your university is going to host a welcome party for new international students. Write a notice (or an announcement) in the name of the Students' Union to

(1) briefly introduce the party, and

(2) invite the international students to attend it.

Write your answer in about 100 words on the ANSWER SHEET.

Do not use your own name in your notice; use "The Students' Union" instead. (10 points)

范文

Notice/Announcement

Friday, June 10

It is so great to① hear that you, international students, have arrived at our university. This notice/announcement is for the purpose of inviting you to attend a welcome party.

To begin with, the party is scheduled to start at 19:00 on June 20 in the Center of Students' Activities and last for approximately two hours. In addition, this party is characterized by a variety of interesting activities, including singing, dancing, Chinese culture introduction, and fun competitions. Of course, some traditional Chinese snacks will be served at the party. To conclude, it is advisable for you to participate in this party, which will bring you opportunities to make friends, arouse your passion for the campus life, and help you know China better.

Finally, we are looking forward to your participation.

The Students' Union

(136 words)

① 全书参考范文中加粗的内容为功能句。

参考译文

通知/告示

6月10日，星期五

很高兴得知各位留学生已经抵校。本通知/告示旨在邀请各位参加欢迎会。

首先，欢迎会定于6月20日19:00在学生活动中心举行，时长约2小时。此外，这次欢迎会的特色是活动精彩丰富，包括唱歌、跳舞、中国文化介绍和趣味比赛。当然，欢迎会上还会提供一些中国传统小吃。总之，建议你们参加这次欢迎会，它将带给你们结交新朋友的机会，激发你们对校园生活的热情，并帮助你们更好地了解中国。

最后，期待你们的参与。

学生会

词汇预习

  1. attend v. 参加，出席
  2. schedule v. 为……安排时间
  3. approximately adv. 大约
  4. characterize v. 使……具有特点
  5. a variety of 各种各样的，多种的
  6. snack n. 点心，小吃
  7. advisable adj. 明智的，可取的
  8. participate v. 参加（派 participation n. 参加）
  9. opportunity n. 机会
  10. arouse v. 激起，引起
  11. campus n.（大学）校园，校区

小作文02 邮件：建议＋说明

题目要求

Directions:

Suppose a foreign friend of yours has been looking for AI tools to enhance learning efficiency. Write him/her an e-mail to make a recommendation and explain your reasons.

Write your answer in about 100 words on the ANSWER SHEET.

Do not use your own name in your e-mail; use "Li Ming" instead. (10 points)

范文

Dear Sky,

I am quite pleased to hear that you are looking for AI tools to promote learning efficiency. Today, I am writing to make a recommendation.

It is advisable for you to try out several AI tools in learning since it is by trying them out that you can know which one can best suit your needs. A case in point is myself. As a senior who is preparing for the national entrance exams for postgraduate studies, I tried ERNIE Bot, Tongyi, and Kimi. In the end, I chose Kimi, which is characterized by its excellent performance in information collection. This AI tool can bring me high efficiency, inspire my passion for learning, and help me save time and energy.

I am looking forward to discussing more details of the AI tools after you use them.

Best wishes,Li Ming

(141 words)

参考译文

亲爱的斯凯：

很高兴得知你在寻找AI工具来提高学习效率。今天我写信来是想做个推荐。

建议你在学习中尝试几个AI工具，因为通过试用这些工具，你能够知道哪个最符合你的需求。一个典型的例子就是我自己。作为一名正在准备全国研究生入学考试的大四学生，我试过文心一言、通义和Kimi。最终，我选择了Kimi，它的特点是在信息搜集方面表现出色。这个AI工具能够让我更高效，激发我对学习的热情，并帮助我节省时间和精力。

等你试用之后，我期待跟你探讨AI工具的更多细节。

祝好李明

词汇预习

  1. promote v. 增进，促进
  2. efficiency n. 效率
  3. recommendation n. 推荐
  4. try out 试用，试验
  5. suit one's needs 满足某人的需要
  6. a case in point 恰当的例证
  7. in the end 最终
  8. excellent adj. 优秀的，极好的
  9. performance n. 表现

小作文03 邮件：介绍＋建议

题目要求

Directions:

Suppose you are a senior student. Read the following e-mail from a first-year student in your department and write a reply.

Dear Li Ming,

I've heard that our university has launched a peer mentoring program for new students, but I don't know much about it. Could you give me more details?

Yours,Michael

Write your answer in about 100 words on the ANSWER SHEET.

Do not use your own name in your e-mail; use "Li Ming" instead. (10 points)

范文

Dear Michael,

I'm quite pleased to know that you are interested in the peer mentoring program for new students. Today, I am writing for the purpose of introducing certain details.

This program pairs freshmen with seniors to help them adapt to college life. To begin with, college life is characterized by the fact that students have more spare time. Then, compared with high schools, there are a wider variety of campus activities, clubs and organizations in college. Thus we, as senior students, are supposed to help you develop a new pace of study and life suited for college. To conclude, it's advisable for you to sign up for the peer mentoring program. I'm convinced that you will benefit a lot from it.

Of course, if you have any other questions, please feel free to ask me.

Yours truly,Li Ming

(140 words)

参考译文

亲爱的迈克尔：

得知你对面向新生的同伴指导项目感兴趣，我十分高兴。今天我写这封信是想介绍一些相关细节。

本项目将新生与高年级学生结对，来帮助他们适应大学生活。首先，大学生活的特点是学生拥有更多空闲时间。其次，与高中相比，大学里有更加丰富多样的校园活动、社团和学生组织。因此，作为高年级学生，我们应当帮助你们形成一套新的、适合大学的学习和生活节奏。总之，建议你报名参加同伴指导项目。我相信你将会从中获益良多。

当然，如果你还有其他问题，随时可以问我。

谨上李明

词汇预习

  1. mentor v. 指导，培训
  2. adapt to 适应（新情况）
  3. spare adj. 空闲的
  4. develop v. 获得，形成
  5. sign up for 报名参加

小作文04 邮件：感谢＋邀请

题目要求

Directions:

Suppose you received much help from Prof. Thomas during your summer study abroad program. Write an e-mail to

(1) thank him, and

(2) invite him to visit China.

Write your answer in about 100 words on the ANSWER SHEET.

Do not use your own name in your e-mail; use "Li Ming" instead. (10 points)

范文

Dear Prof. Thomas,

I am quite pleased to recall the summer when I attended the study abroad program in your country. Today, I am writing for the purpose of extending my gratitude and inviting you to visit China.

To begin with, it was your tremendous help that enabled me to enjoy a comfortable and fruitful trip of learning. Thus, I am deeply grateful to you for your help. In addition, I know that you are fond of China's ancient architecture. Accordingly, I deem that it is advisable for you to visit in person the Great Wall, the Summer Palace, the Forbidden City and so on in your spare time.

I am looking forward to your favorable reply at your earliest convenience so that I can repay you.

Yours sincerely,Li Ming

(131 words)

参考译文

亲爱的托马斯教授：

回想起在贵国参加留学项目的那个暑假，我非常高兴。今天写信来是想表达感谢，并邀请您来中国旅行。

首先，正是您的鼎力相助，使我得享一段舒适且获益良多的学习之旅。因此，我非常感激您的帮助。此外，我知道您很喜欢中国的古建筑。因此，我觉得您可以在闲暇时亲自参观一下长城、颐和园和故宫等。

期待早日收到您的肯定答复，好让我报答您。

谨上李明

词汇预习

  1. recall v. 记起，回忆起
  2. extend v. 提供，给予
  3. gratitude n. 感激之情，感谢
  4. tremendous adj. 巨大的，极大的
  5. fruitful adj. 成果丰硕的
  6. be fond of 喜欢……，爱好……
  7. architecture n. 建筑
  8. accordingly adv. 因此
  9. deem v. 认为
  10. in person 亲自
  11. the Summer Palace 颐和园
  12. the Forbidden City 故宫
  13. favorable adj. 肯定的
  14. repay v. 报答，回报

小作文05 邮件：建议＋说明

题目要求

Directions:

Read the following e-mail from one of your foreign friends and write a reply.

Dear Li Ming,

I'm going to participate in a speech contest on Chinese culture, but I haven't decided on my topic yet. Could you give me some advice? Maybe we could arrange a time to discuss it over a video call. Looking forward to your reply!

Yours,Jane

Write your answer in about 100 words on the ANSWER SHEET.

Do not use your own name in your e-mail; use "Li Ming" instead. (10 points)

范文

Dear Jane,

So glad to hear that you are going to participate in a speech contest on Chinese culture. I am writing to suggest a topic.

To begin with, it is advisable for you to choose China's ancient architecture as your topic since China is characterized by its time-honored history and I know that you are fond of China's ancient buildings. In addition, you are supposed to visit the Great Wall, the Summer Palace, and the Forbidden City, which will bring you distinctive experience, arouse your passion for Chinese culture, and help you prepare fully for the contest.

Finally, if you have any other questions, please call me and I will be available every Friday morning.

Best wishes,Li Ming

(120 words)

参考译文

亲爱的简：

很高兴得知你打算参加关于中国文化的演讲比赛。我写信来是想推荐一个主题。

首先，我建议你选择中国古代建筑作为演讲主题，因为中国的特点是历史悠久，而且我知道你很喜欢中国的古代建筑。此外，你可以去参观一下长城、颐和园和故宫，这将会带给你独特的体验，唤起你对中国文化的热情，并帮助你为比赛做好充分的准备。

最后，如果你有任何问题，可以给我打电话，我每周五早上都有空。

祝好李明

词汇预习

  1. contest n. 比赛
  2. time-honored adj. 历史悠久的
  3. distinctive adj. 独特的
  4. available adj. 有空的

小作文06 邮件：道歉＋建议

题目要求

Directions:

Suppose your foreign friend James is coming to China this Saturday. You originally planned to pick him up at the airport, but could not make it now. Write him an e-mail to

(1) make an apology, and

(2) propose a solution.

Write your answer in about 100 words on the ANSWER SHEET.

Do not use your own name in your e-mail; use "Li Ming" instead. (10 points)

范文

Dear James,

I am quite pleased to hear that you are coming to China and I originally planned to pick you up at the airport. However, I am writing for the purpose of making an apology since I am afraid I can't make it.

You know that during the past half year, I have been exceedingly busy because I allocated nearly all my time and energy for preparing for the national entrance exams for postgraduate studies, which is of great significance to me. Then, due to my carelessness, I did not notice that the date of the test is the day when you will arrive in China until two minutes ago. Accordingly, I have no option but to ask my best friend, Sky, to pick you up at the airport this Saturday.

I am deeply sorry and I plan to show you around Beijing after the test.

Best wishes,Li Ming

(151 words)

参考译文

亲爱的詹姆斯：

很高兴得知你将来到中国，我原本计划去机场接你。但是，我写信来是想道歉，因为我恐怕去不了了。

你知道我过去半年特别忙，因为我几乎把所有时间和精力都用在了准备全国研究生入学考试上，这个考试对我来说非常重要。而且，由于我的粗心，直到两分钟前我才意识到考试当天就是你抵达中国的那天。因此，我别无选择，只能请我最好的朋友斯凯本周六去机场接你。

真的很抱歉。等考完试以后，我计划带你在北京四处逛逛。

祝好李明

词汇预习

  1. originally adv. 原来，起初
  2. apology n. 道歉
  3. exceedingly adv. 非常
  4. allocate v. 分配……（给）
  5. due to 因为，由于
  6. option n. 可选择的事物，选择

小作文07 邮件：申请＋说明

题目要求

Directions:

Suppose you are to write an e-mail applying for a volunteer position at the Center of Cultural Interchange. Write an e-mail to the organization to

(1) express your intention, and

(2) show why you are qualified.

Write your answer in about 100 words on the ANSWER SHEET.

Do not use your own name in your e-mail; use "Li Ming" instead. (10 points)

范文

Dear Sir/Madam,

As a senior student at Peking University who is quite interested in cultural communication, I am writing for the purpose of applying for the volunteer position at your center.

I am convinced that I am qualified for this position for two reasons. To begin with, during my college years, I have devoted nearly all my time and energy to my major, Cross-cultural Exchange. It was my hard work that enabled me to accumulate adequate professional knowledge and skills. In addition, compared with others, I possess richer experience in communicating with foreigners, since I have served as a volunteer for several international conferences.

If I am lucky enough to be a volunteer for your center, I will do my utmost to fulfill my duties.

Yours sincerely,Li Ming

(129 words)

参考译文

尊敬的先生/女士：

作为北京大学的一名大四学生，我对文化交流非常感兴趣，写信来是为了申请贵中心的志愿者岗位。

我坚信我可以胜任这个岗位，原因有两个。首先，在大学期间，我几乎把所有时间和精力都投入我的专业"跨文化交流"中。正是努力学习使我积累了足够的专业知识和技能。此外，与其他人相比，我与外国人交流的经验更丰富，因为我曾担任过数场国际会议的志愿者。

如果我有幸成为贵中心的志愿者，我将尽最大努力履行我的职责。

谨上李明

词汇预习

  1. volunteer n. 志愿者
  2. convinced adj. 确信的
  3. qualified adj. 有资格的
  4. devote ... to ... 把……用于……
  5. accumulate v. 积累
  6. adequate adj. 足够的
  7. possess v. 拥有
  8. serve v. 担任（职务）
  9. international conference 国际会议
  10. do one's utmost 尽最大努力
  11. fulfill v. 履行

小作文08 邮件：感谢＋建议

题目要求

Directions:

Suppose you have just taken part in a one-day career exploration program organized by your university's Career Center. Write an e-mail to the program coordinators to

(1) express your thanks,

(2) briefly describe what you learned from the program, and

(3) make one suggestion for future programs.

Write your answer in about 100 words on the ANSWER SHEET.

Do not use your own name in your e-mail; use "Li Ming" instead. (10 points)

范文

Dear Sir/Madam,

So excited to recall the one-day career exploration program organized by you. Today, I am writing to express my thanks and make one suggestion.

This program did help us broaden our horizons, inspire our passion for exploring future career paths, and provide us with an opportunity to put theoretical knowledge into practice. Thus, we are quite grateful to you for your excellent organization. However, compared with students' practical requirements, the duration and depth of the program were not sufficient. Therefore, it is advisable for our university's Career Center to organize more programs lasting two days or longer to further our career exploration.

Finally, I am convinced that with your support, students will benefit more from future programs.

Best wishes,Li Ming

(124 words)

参考译文

尊敬的先生/女士：

回想起您组织的一日职业探索项目，我十分激动。今天我写这封信，是为了向您表达感谢，并提出一条建议。

该项目确实帮助我们开阔了视野，激发了我们探索未来职业道路的热情，并为我们提供了一个将理论知识运用于实践的机会。因此，我们非常感谢您出色的组织工作。然而，相较于学生的实际需求，该项目的持续时间与探索深度都尚有不足。所以，建议我校就业指导中心组织更多为期两天或更长时间的项目，以此促进我们的职业探索。

最后，我坚信，在您的支持下，学生将会从未来的项目中获得更多益处。

祝好李明

词汇预习

  1. broaden one's horizons 开阔眼界
  2. theoretical knowledge 理论知识
  3. requirement n. [常用复数] 所需的（或所要的）东西
  4. duration n. 持续时间
  5. sufficient adj. 足够的，充足的

小作文09 邮件：建议＋鼓励

题目要求

Directions:

Suppose your friend Jack did not do well in his maths midterm exam. He wrote you an e-mail asking for advice. Write him a reply to

(1) give your advice, and

(2) encourage him.

Write your answer in about 100 words on the ANSWER SHEET.

Do not use your own name in your e-mail; use "Li Ming" instead. (10 points)

范文

Dear Jack,

I am deeply sorry to hear that you did not do well in your recent maths midterm exam. Today, I am writing for the purpose of sharing my suggestions and encouraging you.

To begin with, it is advisable for you to prepare in advance since it is full preparation that enables you to accumulate adequate knowledge and skills for the test. A case in point is myself. Compared with others, I am not smarter, but full preparation can bring me confidence, arouse my passion for learning, and help me succeed in maths tests. In addition, it is of great necessity for you to summarize your errors as success derives from failure.

To conclude, I am convinced that if you do your utmost to prepare and practice in advance, you will do better in the next exam.

Best wishes,Li Ming

(142 words)

参考译文

亲爱的杰克：

很遗憾得知最近的数学期中考试你没考好。今天，我写信来是想分享一些我的建议并给你一些鼓励。

首先，建议你提前准备，因为正是充分的准备使你能够积累足够的知识和考试技巧。一个典型的例子就是我自己。与其他人相比，我不算聪明，但充分的准备能够带给我自信，唤起我对学习的热情，并帮助我在数学考试中获得成功。此外，你还有必要总结自己的错误，因为失败是成功之母。

总之，我坚信，你如果竭尽全力提前准备和练习，下次会考得更好。

祝好李明

词汇预习

  1. midterm adj. 学期中间的，期中的
  2. in advance 预先，事先
  3. necessity n. 必要，需要
  4. summarize v. 总结
  5. error n. 错误，差错
  6. derive from 起源于，来自

小作文10 会议纪要（新大纲）

题目要求

Directions:

Suppose your class held a meeting to discuss how to prevent food waste in daily life. Please write the minutes for the meeting. Your minutes should include

(1) basic information about the discussion, and

(2) issues and solutions raised in the discussion.

Write your answer in about 100 words on the ANSWER SHEET.

Do not use your own name in your minutes; use "Li Ming" instead. (10 points)

题目解读

纪要一般指会议纪要，是2027年大纲中提到的小作文考查形式之一。在写作时，一定要先看清题目要求写哪些内容。通常情况下，一篇纪要需要包含会议的基本信息，如时间、地点、参会人员、会议主题、会议内容等，会议内容可能涉及会议各环节做了什么、最终得出什么结论等。

这种题型看上去很新，但实际上在写作时，仍旧可以大量运用功能句。如果考试考到了，大家也不用担心，只需审好题，并参考下面范文的思路写作即可。

范文

Minutes

This meeting was for the purpose of discussing how to prevent food waste in everyday life and finally all participants came to the same conclusion.

The meeting began at 14:00 on June 20 in Classroom 201 and lasted for two hours. Professor Sky raised the question and pointed out that compared to the past years, we enjoy a richer life and thus an increasing number of youngsters do not cherish food. Then, all classmates agreed that this phenomenon is particularly worth attention. We deemed that it is of great necessity for us to stop wasting not only food, but also time, electricity, water, and the like.

The conclusion is that we are supposed to take immediate actions to prevent food waste in daily life, such as only buying what we need and not throwing away leftovers.

Minutes recorder: Li Ming

(141 words)

参考译文

会议纪要

本次会议旨在讨论如何在日常生活中避免食物浪费，最终所有与会人员得出一致结论。

会议于6月20日14:00在201教室举行，持续时长为2小时。斯凯教授提出了这一问题，并指出，与过去相比，我们的生活更加富裕，于是越来越多的年轻人不珍惜食物。接着，全班同学一致同意这一现象非常值得关注。大家认为，我们不仅很有必要杜绝食物浪费，还要避免浪费时间、电、水以及其他类似资源。

结论是，我们应该立刻采取行动来避免日常生活中的食物浪费，例如只买需要的，以及不扔掉剩饭剩菜。

记录人：李明

词汇预习

  1. minute n. [~s] 会议记录
  2. participant n. 参加者
  3. come to a conclusion 得出结论
  4. raise v. 提起，提出
  5. cherish v. 珍惜
  6. phenomenon n. 现象
  7. like n. 类似的人（或物）
  8. immediate adj. 立刻的
  9. leftover n. [常用复数] 吃剩的饭菜

notes.title: 小作文模版
notes.html:
第一部分：核心高分语料库 (万能连接词与高级句型)

在背诵模版前，请掌握这些能瞬间提升作文档次的词汇和句型，它们可以嵌入任何书信或通知中。

1. 逻辑连接词（黄金词）
  • 表示递进/补充： Moreover (此外), Furthermore (而且), In addition (另外), What is more (更重要的是).
  • 表示转折： However (然而), Nevertheless (尽管如此), Unfortunately (不幸的是).
  • 表示因果： Consequently (因此), Due to the fact that... (由于...), As a result (结果).
  • 表示目的： For the purpose of... (为了...), In order to... (为了).
2. 高级句型（万能套用）
  • 建议句型： It is advisable/highly recommended for you to... (强烈建议你……)
  • 重要性句型： ... plays a vital/indispensable role in... (……在……中起着至关重要的作用)
  • 感谢句型： I would like to convey my heartfelt gratitude to you for... (我想对你……表达我诚挚的谢意)
  • 期待句型： I am looking forward to your favorable reply at your earliest convenience. (期待您尽早的佳音)
  • 通知开头： The Student Union is planning to host/organize [Event Name]. (学生会计划举办……)

第二部分：2026 考研英语一小作文预测排名与模版

趋势分析：英语一的小作文通常在书信（建议、邀请、推荐、道歉）和告示（通知）之间轮换。

  • 2024、2025 年连续考了书信（建议/回复类）。
  • 因此，2026 年考察「通知（Notice）」的概率极大提升。
  • 同时，「邀请信」和「道歉信」这类很久未考的书信体也是重点防备对象。
预测第一名：通知 (Notice)

理由： 自 2023 年以来未考，且是考研英语一的传统强项。特别是招募志愿者或活动通知。参考范文改编： (结合文件 2 中的“中文演讲比赛”和“英语俱乐部”通知)

【万能模版：活动/招募通知】

Notice

Date: December 20, 2025

To enhance the students' awareness of [Topic: e.g., environmental protection/traditional culture] and enrich our campus life, the Student Union is continuously recruiting volunteers for the upcoming [Activity Name: e.g., International Cultural Festival]. The details are listed as follows.

First of all, the activity is scheduled to be held at [Place] on [Time]. Secondly, the main responsibilities of volunteers include [Task 1: e.g., guiding guests] and [Task 2: e.g., maintaining order]. Last but not least, candidates who are fluent in spoken English and possess a strong sense of responsibility will be given priority.

Anyone interested in this voluntary work is welcome to send an application to [Email Address] before [Deadline]. Please do not hesitate to join us!

The Student Union

预测第二名：邀请信 (Letter of Invitation)

理由： 邀请信是极其正式的公务书信，上次考察是 2022 年，符合隔 3-4 年考察一次的频率。场景： 邀请外教/教授做评委、参加毕业典礼或文化活动。

【万能模版：邀请专家/朋友】

Dear Professor Smith / [Friend's Name],

I am writing on behalf of [Class 3 / the Student Union] to extend a sincere invitation to you to attend/participate in the [Event Name], which will be held in [Place] on [Time].

The primary reason for this invitation is that you are an expert in this field. We firmly believe that your presence will not only encourage all the students present but also provide professional guidance for us. Furthermore, we have arranged a special session for you to share your insights on [Topic].

We would be extremely honored if you could accept our invitation. Please let us know your decision at your earliest convenience so that we can make further preparations.

Yours sincerely,Li Ming

预测第三名：推荐信 (Letter of Recommendation)

理由： 英语一的“王炸”题型，虽然近年考过，但因其可考性极强（推荐书、电影、城市、景点、文化），永远不能掉以轻心。文件 2 中重点预测了推荐景点和名人。场景： 给外国朋友推荐中国传统文化、旅游景点或书籍。

【万能模版：推荐中国文化/旅游/书籍】

Dear Paul,

I am writing this email to recommend a fascinating [city/book/movie], [Name of the item], to you, which I believe will be of great interest to you.

The reasons for my recommendation are as follows. To begin with, as a symbol of Chinese traditional culture, it possesses profound historical significance and unique charm. Moreover, it is widely acknowledged that [Name] has inspired generations of people, and I am sure you will be impressed by its [unique feature: e.g., breathtaking scenery / deep philosophy]. It serves as a window for you to understand the real China.

I hope you will enjoy it. If you need further information, please feel free to contact me.

Yours sincerely,Li Ming

预测第四名：道歉信 (Letter of Apology)

理由： 超级黑马。 英语一自 2008 年后再没考过纯粹的道歉信。根据“冷门回补”原则，极有可能突袭。场景： 错过面试、弄丢借的东西、无法赴约。

【万能模版：因故无法出席/失误】

Dear [Name],

I am writing to express my sincerest apologies for [not being able to attend the meeting / losing the book you lent me]. I am truly sorry for any inconvenience this may have caused you.

The reason is that [Reason: e.g., I suddenly fell ill / I was caught in an unexpected emergency] yesterday. To make up for my fault, I would like to [Solution: e.g., reschedule the appointment / buy a new copy for you] at your convenience. I promise that such a mistake will never occur again.

Once again, please accept my deepest apologies. I am looking forward to your forgiveness.

Yours sincerely,Li Ming

预测第五名：会议纪要 (Minutes)

理由： 文件 2 中王江涛预测的第 10 篇是会议纪要。虽然这通常是英语二的考点，但大纲中英语一也有此要求。如果考出来会是“大杀器”，因为大部分人没背格式。只需记住格式即可防身。

【万能格式模版】

Minutes of the Meeting on [Meeting Topic]

Time: 2:00 p.m. - 4:00 p.m., December 20, 2025Place: The Conference Room, LibraryPresent: All members of the Student UnionPresided by: Li Ming

Summary of the meeting:The meeting aimed to discuss [Topic: e.g., the plan for the Charity Sale]. Decisions were made as follows:

  1. Firstly, it was agreed that the event will take place next Friday to ensure maximum participation.
  2. Secondly, Wang Hua was assigned to be responsible for the promotion and poster design.
  3. Finally, all the funds raised will be donated to Project Hope to help children in rural areas.

Submitted by: Li Ming

考场策略总结 (Exam Strategy)

  1. 审题第一： 拿到卷子先看是 Letter (书信) 还是 Notice (通知)。
    • 如果是 Notice，一定要写标题（居中），日期（右上角），落款（右下角）。
    • 如果是 Letter，注意称呼和落款格式。
  2. 不要使用真名： 永远使用 "Li Ming" 或 "The Student Union"（除非题目另有规定），绝对不要签自己的名字。
  3. 字数控制： 题目要求 100 词左右，建议写 100-120 词。不要写太长，容易出错且浪费时间。
  4. 卷面整洁： 哪怕字写得不好看，也要工整，不要涂改。

祝你在 12 月 20 日的考试中，小作文拿下高分！
